points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Explicit official validator invocation returned OK for every case and solver/report.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: All eight metadata files mark completed with converged/statistically_periodic status; Re200 reaches t=300.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Most force/field evidence is plausible, but the cylinder steady MPI result is order-one inconsistent and rank validation prose is false.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Report includes named Mach, pressure, residual, force and surface plots plus Re200 vorticity, with figure manifest.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Strong technical coverage and candid plateau note, but table 5 falsely reports cylinder np1/2/4 Cd=1.953 while retained artifacts have 5.706.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Workspace report has figure/run manifests; curated commit excludes raw result data and report-generated manifests, limiting self-contained traceability.

disqualification_flags.flag: Figure files misnamed (e.g., Mach image that actually plots pressure)
Report figures do not correspond to submitted field/CSV outputs
Placeholder, synthetic, or intentionally partial result files in scored case dirs
metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful
Debug outputs presented as final case results
